name: Sega Master System / Mark III
_notes: pause is a console button, not a pad button; emulators map it to Start. 1 is left of 2 on the pad, so 1=south and 2=east, as in Genesis Plus GX (RetroPad B->1, A->2). Game Gear (start instead of pause) would be its own layout if added. Many SMS games use 1 to start and 2 to act, so confirm=one.
